test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

The school usually starts at 8 a.m. and is closing at 3 p.m.
solution:
The correct answer is '**is closing at 3 p.m.**' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the present continuous tense 'is closing **at 3 p.m**' is incorrect.
 
• We use the **present continuous** to talk about **actions that are happening at the present moment but will soon finish**.
 
 
• The **present continuous tense**: **to be (am, is, are) + verb (the present participle)**
 
 
 
• The given sentence is talking about a general routine of opening and closing times of the school.
 
• We use the **present simple tense** when we want to talk about **fixed habits or routines – things that don't change**.
 
 
• The **simple present tense** is formed by using **the root form or by adding ‑s or ‑es to the end**.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the **present simple tense ''closes at 3 p.m''** should be used **in place of** the **present continuous tense ''is closing **at 3 p.m**''**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *The school usually starts at 8 a.m. and **closes at 3 p.m***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, present continuous tense 'is closing at 3 p.m' गलत है।
 
• हम present continuous का उपयोग **उन कार्यों के बारे में** बात करने के लिए करते हैं **जो वर्तमान क्षण में हो रहे हैं लेकिन जल्द ही समाप्त हो जाएंगे**।
 
 
• Present continuous tense: to be (am, is, are) + verb (the present participle)
 
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **स्कूल के खुलने और बंद होने के समय की सामान्य दिनचर्या के बारे में बात कर रहा है**।
 
• हम present simple tense का उपयोग तब करते हैं **जब हम निश्चित आदतों या दिनचर्या के बारे में **बात करना चाहते हैं - ऐसी चीजें जो नहीं बदलती हैं।
 
 
• Simple present tense मूल रूप का उपयोग करके या अंत में s या ‑es जोड़कर बनता है।
 
 
 
• इसलिए, present continuous tense ''is closing at 3 p.m'' के स्थान पर present simple tense ''closes at 3 p.m'' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

सही वाक्य: *The school usually starts at 8 a.m. and closes at 3 p.m*.
